auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to access your Vyoog products and workspace.
auth.mfaSubtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
auth.platformMfaSubtitle: Enter your verification code to finish signing in.
auth.platformMfaHint: Enter your 6-digit authenticator code, or a recovery code if you've lost access to your authenticator.
auth.useOrganizationSso: Sign in with your organization's SSO instead
auth.ssoSubtitle: Enter your organization's code to sign in through its own identity provider.
auth.ssoNotAvailable: Single sign-on isn't set up for that organization code.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Control how the portal looks and how dates, numbers, and menus are shown to you.
preferences.reducedMotionHint: Turns off this app's own entrance animations and hover motion, on top of whatever your operating system already prefers.
preferences.regionHint: Controls date and number formatting (e.g. day/month order) — separate from your time zone below.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage two-factor authentication for your account
security.loadError: Could not load your security settings.
security.sessionsLoadError: Could not load your active sessions.
security.enableDescription: Add an authenticator app as a second factor required at sign-in, on top of your password.
security.setupStep1: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
security.manualKeyHint: Can't scan it? Enter this key manually: {{secret}}
security.recoveryCodesWarning: Store these somewhere secure — each one can be used once, in place of your authenticator code, if you lose access to it. They won't be shown again.
security.confirmPasswordAndCode: Confirm your password and a current authenticator (or recovery) code.
security.oldCodesWarning: Your old codes no longer work. Store these somewhere secure — they won't be shown again.

orgSettings.title: Organization settings
orgSettings.mfaHint: Changes apply at each member's next sign-in. Nobody is signed out.
orgSettings.mfaRequired: MFA is required for every member of this organization.
orgSettings.mfaNotRequired: MFA is not required for members of this organization.
orgSettings.mfaSaveError: Could not update the MFA requirement.
orgSettings.name: Name
orgSettings.roleSaveError: Could not change this member's role.

privilegedAccess.title: Elevated access
privilegedAccess.subtitle: Request temporary access to a permission you don't normally have. An administrator must approve it, and it ends automatically.
privilegedAccess.noRequestable: There are no permissions you can request.
privilegedAccess.loadError: Could not load privileged access requests.

adminRbac.rolesSubtitle: Roles and the permissions each one grants.
adminRbac.name: Name
adminRbac.immutableHint: The name and scope cannot be changed after creation.
adminRbac.immutableNameHint: The name cannot be changed after creation.

saml.keepConnectionHint: Only the name is changed. Choose another option to replace the entity ID, SSO URL and certificate.
saml.saveError: Could not update this SAML provider.

adminOrgLifecycle.editHint: The organization code ({{code}}), seats, MFA policy and parent organization are not changed here.
adminOrgLifecycle.actionError: Could not change the organization's status.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.body: Every active member's login is disabled and their sessions are ended. Nothing is deleted. You can activate the organization again later.

activate.title: Activate {{name}}?
activate.body: Every active member's login is enabled again. An administrator who has not yet verified their email stays disabled until they do.

close.title: Close {{name}}?
close.body: The organization is closed and every active member's login is disabled. Its data, members and history are kept, and it can be activated again. A closed organization cannot be edited.

adminOrgLifecycle.partialFailure: Keycloak did not update these logins: {{emails}}. Repeat the same action to retry.

fields.name: Name
fields.billingSameAsAddress: Billing address is the same as the organization address
